title: NASA's Mars fact sheet: mass 0.64169×10^24 kg, orbit 686.980 days
summary: The sheet lists Mars's mass as 0.64169 × 10^24 kg, equatorial radius 3396.2 km, mean density 3934 kg/m^3, surface gravity 3.73 m/s^2, sidereal orbit 686.980 days, and 2 natural satellites.
body: The sheet lists Mars's mass as 0.64169 × 10^24 kg, equatorial radius 3396.2 km, mean density 3934 kg/m^3, surface gravity 3.73 m/s^2, sidereal orbit 686.980 days, and 2 natural satellites. The atmosphere section states a surface pressure of 6.36 mb at mean radius, and says that pressure varies with season. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last updated on the page: 2025-05-19.
